terms: I commit to the daily process: the cold shower, the walk with time with God, my Big 3, and at least 30 minutes of Side Hustle Summit work or my set number of outreach calls or DMs.
I will earn $20,000 in profit from my digital product and software work by my graduation from Cal Poly, and my first milestone is earning back my $2,000 investment.
Faithfulness means slow progress does not move me off the plan. I trust God's path and keep showing up through the quiet and hard stretches.
When I fall short, I give myself graceful accountability and redirect with intention.
I review this contract every month.
